remediated_deficiencies.summary: Fixed fail-open behavior where allowed_signal_ids defaulted to None when decisions were empty, allowing consideration of prior candidate signals in the database. Now strictly initializes allowed_signal_ids = frozenset() and allow_entries = False.

Query existing BUY_TO_OPEN intents directly in SQLite before evaluating candidates. If an entry intent already exists, permanently lock out new entries across all cycles and crashes. Added write_stop_marker_durable with atomic write, flush, fsync, and os.replace that fails closed on OSError.

Decoupled entry lockout (allow_entries=False) from service reconciliation (process_closes=True). The live service continues monitoring resting orders, broker fills, and exit signals until the single trade has fully settled and all positions are closed.

Enforced mutual exclusion between SwiftAutoTrader-Paper-Local and SwiftAutoTrader-Live-Local at both PowerShell task scheduler level and Python single_instance file locking level (service.lock and supervisor.lock).

Implemented 12 dedicated regression tests in tests/unit/test_supervised_lifecycle.py covering simultaneous alerts, prior recorded signals, scope filtering, crash recovery, approval blocking, and full lifecycle settlement.
